results.name: Empty silk on an undecorated board is not a false missing-art error
Top and bottom silk text survives actual text readback
Each required generated layer is checked independently
Malformed Gerber is reported without pretending it was inspected
Print-enabled source with dark output removed triggers invariant failure
All-ink-erasing clear rectangle triggers a prominent sampled warning
Printed text entirely outside board is flagged as zero retained samples
Some clipped strokes do not incorrectly label the entire layer empty
Via drills and NPTH slots are compared by coordinates and diameter
Missing drill file cannot be exported as matching the design
Same drill count with shifted coordinates is rejected
Gerber region contours use UNION even with nested or reversed paths
Later dark geometry can restore ink removed by a clear operation
Review works for compatibility Gerber and optional paste files
Report is tied to the design identity and explicitly not CAM approval
Inspection leaves source document and generated text unchanged
